header.title: Archived Classes
header.description: Classes you've archived. Restore them anytime, or delete permanently.

empty.noClassesDesc: Classes you archive will appear here. Archived classes are hidden from your main view but can be restored anytime.

delete.confirmDesc: This will permanently remove {{name}} along with all join requests and enrollments. This action cannot be undone.

tip.label: Tip:
tip.text: Restoring a class brings it back to your active classes with all its materials and enrollments intact. Permanent deletion is only available to teachers.

toasts.classRestoredDesc: {{name}} is back in your active classes.
